evaluation.purpose: P1 correctness complete; performance adoption withheld. Do not call 16 req/s maximum sustainable throughput.

timing.note: Execution sum excludes preflight, fingerprints, investigation and gaps; observed span includes gaps and is not total implementation time.

limits: Historical P0 comparison; no same-session randomized P0/P1 causal attribution.
Warmup/execution history differs between cold failures and late 22 req/s success.
16 req/s p99 has fewer than 10000 samples per run; descriptive only.
P1 adds no heap/GC tuning or P2/P3 optimization.

detailSource: Full endpoint/resource distributions, preparation runs and raw samples are retained in the Release archive summary.json and per-run files. This repository summary projects the same 53 runs without changing values.
